title: Personal Checking Fee Determination: Charges for Items Paid into Overdraft and Items Returned Unpaid
content:
Each item paid into overdraft on a Personal Checking account incurs the tier's charge for an item paid into overdraft, recorded against that debit. Each item returned unpaid incurs the tier's charge for a returned item, recorded against the returned item.

**Floors and conditions in force.**

1. No overdraft charge arises on an item whose amount is at or below the tier's item floor.
2. No overdraft or returned-item charge arises for a business day whose end-of-day ledger balance is negative by the tier's day floor or less.
3. A tier charge of 0.00 means no charge is written at all.
4. The charge is assessed only on an account whose status is active, read from the account record before the charge is written.
5. Each item can carry at most one overdraft-item or returned-item charge, the item itself identifying the charge.
6. Charges never apply to credits, to the bank's own charge postings, or to items on a restricted account.

**Clause no longer in force.** One clause of this determination has been superseded by the current charter and is recorded here only so that no reader applies it: the clause limiting overdraft-item and returned-item charges together to the tier's count per account per business day, counted in posting order, with items beyond that count carrying no charge, is **no longer in force**. It may not be used to decide how many charges a business day carries. The floors and the conditions numbered above stand as they are written.

**Worked illustration of the two floors (hypothetical).** An Everyday Checking account has 4 items paid into overdraft on one business day, of 4.00, 30.00, 80.00 and 120.00, and the day ends 220.00 below zero. The item of 4.00 sits at or below the tier's floor of 5.00 and carries nothing. The day ends further below zero than the tier's day floor of 50.00, so the day floor does not protect it either; each of the remaining three items carries the tier's charge of 35.00. Had the day ended 20.00 below zero, the day floor would have held and none of the four items would have carried a charge.

superseded_clauses: Overdraft-item and returned-item fees together are limited to overdraft_daily_item_limit per account per business day, counted by checking_msr_overdraft_fees_day in posting order; items beyond the limit carry no fee.
